profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (EDI) at Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary:
Greetings, I'm Brandt!

I'm a Systems and Infrastructure Engineer with a strong passion for technology and a growing interest in cybersecurity. With experience in support, incident response, and EDI systems, I thrive in fast-paced environments where problem-solving and collaboration are key.

I recently received my CompTIA Security+ certification as I work toward transitioning into a cybersecurity-focused role. I'm deeply committed to continuous learning and excited to contribute to a team where I can grow and make an impact.

Let’s connect and share knowledge as we build the future of tech!

View my portfolio: https://brandt2x.github.io

positions.title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer II
positions.description:
Built real-time monitoring and alerting in SIEM tools, enhancing visibility and speeding issue detection.

Developed a Python script that automated the troubleshooting and resolution of recurring ServiceNow tickets by integrating SQL queries through the PETE API, scheduled via a cron job. This automation resolves 30 tickets per week, saving over 3 hours of manual effort.

Led major incident response calls for business-critical issues, coordinating cross-functional teams, delegating tasks, and managing resolution timelines to reduce system downtime.

Represented the EDI team at Walmart’s New Supplier Workshop, presenting EDI setup, portal functionality, and best practices to ensure seamless supplier onboarding.

Onboarded and trained new hires, leading all aspects of new hire onboarding and ongoing technical mentorship to accelerate ramp-up and team contribution.
positions.insights: Microsoft SQL Server, Attention to Detail and +1 skill

positions.title: Analyst II, System Engineering
positions.description:
Resolved an average of 50 ServiceNow tickets per week, addressing EDI-related issues including document errors, supplier access issues, and profile permission requests.

Provided email support for internal teams and suppliers to quickly resolve EDI-related issues.

Onboarded new suppliers by creating and configuring profiles, assigning access control lists, and validating successful connectivity.

Participated in weekly change and developer meetings, documenting and communicating updates for at least 10 changes per week to ensure team readiness.
positions.insights: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), Python (Programming Language) and +2 skills

positions.title: Leasing Agent
positions.description:
•	Coordinate and lead apartment tours, answer prospects questions, and highlight selling features and property amenities. 
•	Greet, pre-qualify, and follow up with prospective tenants; process and verify eligible tenant applications.
•	Address, investigate, and resolve tenant complaints and document action taken; provide technical assistance over the phone and email. Write and submit work order requests to maintenance department; follow up on maintenance process with residents.

positions.title: Fast Food Team Member
positions.description:
•	Was responsible for providing an exceptional dining experience for every customer served each day.
•	Pleasantly greeted each customer, accurately took orders, adherence to production procedures, delivered food in a timely manner.
•	Stayed connected with guests while dining and sent the guest away with a warm salutation.

organizations.name: Blacks in Computing
organizations.description:
Blacks in Computing mission:
Provide professional development skills to black students in related fields

Provide networking and career opportunities for black students in this field

Mentor young black children off campus and bring awareness to the opportunities available for them in this field 

Helping to provide resources to underclassmen and help the retention rates of black students in related majors
